[SWS_PHM_00229]
{DRAFT}
Switch Global Supervision Status from
kFAILED
to
kSTOPPED
⌈
If the
Global Supervision Status
is
kFAILED
, the
Elemen-
tary Supervision Status
of at least one Alive, Deadline or Logical Supervi-
sion is
kEXPIRED
, the
expiredSupervisionTolerance
is configured to zero and
the
GlobalSupervision
corresponds to Operating System, Execution Manage-
ment or State Management, then the
Platform Health Management
shall change
the
Global Supervision Status
to
kSTOPPED
.
⌋
(RS_PHM_00111, RS_PHM_-
00112)
See transition (12) in figure 7.6.
